coherence_rule: same-sign G1-G2 and G2-G4, min/max magnitude>=0.5; abs(G1-G4)/sigmaMid thresholds3/6; same regional extension; heuristic not probability
impulse_control: point and impulse-noise have identical observed signal, but different ground truth
region_rule: min retention in7x7; outward Gaussian sigma1 fade, min with original; no threshold retuning
scope: known synthetic truth; fixed positive R6-spectral profile, not calibration of injected Gaussian noise; no RAW opened
units: linear Rec.2020 Y/Co/Cg; additive independent Gaussian synthetic noise, not sensor noise truth; fixed spectral profile is deliberately also applied to noise-free controls
